body:
User asked (verbatim, via team-lead brief):
  SE-06 "Quarantine until scanned — file unusable until the scan passes (Box, regulated SaaS). Status on the record (RC-15), scanner is a plugin." Today there is no quarantined state for async scans. Add a quarantined/pending-scan status in records so a file uploaded while a scan is pending cannot be read, served, shared or linked until the scan passes, and is handled (deleted or kept quarantined, configurable) when it fails. Find every read/serve/share/URL path that must respect it (records Store reads, recordshttp, share, variants handler, URL signing) and test each; that enumeration is the point of the feature.

Context:
  Files: records/**, scan/
Acceptance:
  quarantine status enforced on every read/serve/share/URL path, each tested
title: SE-06 quarantine until scanned
